posts.text: My ADHD brain turns procrastination into performance art yet here I am, still thriving.
ADHD scrolling: searching for dopamine, finding nothing.
You don’t need to earn rest just because you have ADHD.
ADHD means my brain refuses to work until it’s 3 minutes before a deadline.
If you’re tired of forgetting the stuff that matters, I built something for that. (It’s ADHD-proof, I swear.)
Grieving the version of you that never got the support she needed
